description: Zeke's Landing and Marina sits just across the street from some of the most beautiful beaches in the country. A mere 10-minute boat ride from the Gulf of Mexico. Zeke's boasts a long history of excellence in the charter fishing industry and proudly hosts the largest charter fleet on the Gulf. For your next saltwater fishing adventure, consider Zeke's Marina. We offer the largest charter fleet on Alabama's Gulf Coast, providing the perfect trip for every angler, regardless of experience level. Additionally, we offer a variety of dry dock options. Our commitment extends to providing premier customer service and adopting an environmentally friendly approach to operating a marina.
